patches.name: rce-security-fix
patches.description: Remote code execution exploit fix: make the .zdata section non-writable. Stock .zdata is RWX (0xE0000040); the RCE exploit writes shellcode there and executes it. Clearing WRITE -> R+X (0x60000040) blocks the write half of W^X, so the exploit still fails, while leaving .zdata executable as a code-cave section (needed by spell-desc-block-value-token; a code cave must be executable, and a non-writable code page runs under DEP). (Was 0xC0000040 RW which stripped EXECUTE and broke .zdata code caves.)
patches.source: Xerrion/WoWFix335 (Zeppelin: clear WRITE instead of EXECUTE)

patches.name: spell-desc-block-value-token
patches.description: Custom spell-description block-value tokens, in BOTH forms. (1) String token $k/$K: hooks the desc token dispatcher (0x57a02d) to print the local player's shield Block Value in prose. (2) Numeric operands usable inside ${...} arithmetic (and thus any spell variable), e.g. $dmg=${$m1+$<perlevel>+$<apbonus>+$bv}: $bv = shield block value (id 0xF0); $HEALTH = max health (id 0xF1, [[player+0xd0]+0x68]); $lvc = player level clamped to 60 (id 0xF2, min([[player+0xd0]+0xc0],60) -- caps per-level speed scaling at level 60, F-005). Added by two extensible hooks on the ${} engine: the operand-name matcher (0x576b50) recognizes the name -> custom id; the operand resolver default (0x578b88) returns the value for that id. Both fall through to stock for any other token, so blast radius is limited to descriptions using $bv. Block value read = [[player+0x1008]+0xdec] (same field GetShieldBlock uses). To add more numeric operands later (align names to Ascension: $w1-3 aura amount, $br block chance, $health), extend the two .zdata caves with more name->id / id->value cases. Caves live in .zdata (made R+X by rce-security-fix).
patches.source: Reverse-engineered F-183/F-164. Dispatcher 0x579e50, emit 0x57aa00, player 0x4038f0; ${} engine parse 0x577530/lexer table 0xace8f8, eval 0x578d10, operand resolver 0x5782d0 (default 0x578b88, return 0x578b99). UNTESTED in-game - verify before relying on it.

patches.name: macro-custom-icon-strings
patches.description: F-181: let CreateMacro/EditMacro accept a STRING icon arg (texture name relative to Interface\Icons) in addition to the stock numeric icon index, so custom macro icons shipped via PATCH-Z work end-to-end (picker, edit UI, action bars, save/load). Macros already store the icon as a bare name string at macro+0x60 (strncpy, 256B); GetMacroInfo returns "Interface\Icons\"+stored, so a string round-trips. (A1) CreateMacro gate 0x568180: lua_isnumber->lua_isstring (0x84df60 accepts both string type4 and number type3), so a string no longer hits the "Usage: CreateMacro(name,iconIndex,...)" error. (A2) CreateMacro icon-resolution 0x5681CB..0x568208 -> jmp caveA (0xDD1200): number=stock path (tonumber->count 0x565c20->iconArray 0x564d70->[ebp-8]); string=lua_tolstring(L,2)->[ebp-8]. (B) EditMacro icon-resolution 0x567001..0x567059 -> jmp caveB (0xDD1300): number=stock; string=lua_tolstring(L,3)->[ebp-0xc]; nil=leave 0 (icon unchanged, e.g. body-only saves). Both caves re-execute the original numeric logic verbatim and only ADD a string branch, so blast radius is limited to macro create/edit. Caves live in .zdata (R+X via rce-security-fix). The F-181 Lua must pass the icon name RELATIVE to Interface\Icons (strip the prefix); GetMacroInfo re-adds it. UNTESTED in-game.
patches.source: Reverse-engineered F-181/F-162. CreateMacro 0x568160, EditMacro 0x566fa0, internal create 0x568020 / edit 0x566cd0 (strncpy icon->macro+0x60), GetMacroInfo 0x566eb0 -> 0x566ac0 (prefix "Interface\Icons\" @0xace1e8). lua_isnumber 0x84df20, lua_isstring 0x84df60, lua_tonumber 0x84e030, lua_tolstring 0x84e0e0. UNTESTED - verify before relying.
